q: Which sandbox setting matters most for stopping data exfiltration?
options: Default-deny network egress with an allowlist
explain: Egress is the way out; close it and stolen data has nowhere to go.

q: What weakness do containers have compared with microVMs?
options: They share the host kernel, so a kernel exploit can escape
explain: MicroVMs give each workload its own kernel.
